name: Benchmark Curve Name 4 Choice
definition: Choice of format for benchmark curve name.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN), when it exists for the reference rate.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Identifier of the index/benchmark of a floating rate bond, when an identifier exists.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Where no identifier exists, standardized name of the index, including its term (such as ‘EURIBOR6M’, ‘LIBOR3M’).
